description:
Dispatch one or more Jules tasks through a single consolidated orchestration call.

Use this when an AI agent has a single task object, an array of task objects, or a YAML/JSON task payload and wants a continuously replenished worker pool with bounded concurrency and optional global launch pacing.

Returns: { success: true, data: { summary: { total, dispatched, failed }, results: [{ taskFile, taskTitle, sessionId, sessionUrl, title, status, error? }] } }

See also: jules_monitor (track dispatched sessions), jules_interact (inspect one session in context), jules_list_sources (find source identifiers)

paceMs.description: Minimum delay in milliseconds between session creation starts across all workers

anyOf.description: YAML or JSON string containing one or more task definitions

name: jules_dispatch
